title: K3 and the lost song.
lines: They sing together in a group.
They sing happy songs and they dance to them.
And everyone dances with their arms in the air.
One day they have a big concert.
It's in the most beautiful hall in the country.
All the children have a ticket.
But in the morning something strange happens.
Hanne can't remember the new song.
The song was written on a sheet of paper.
The wind blew it out of the window.
The new song is the most important part of the concert!
A man with a dog walks by.
Have you seen a sheet of paper?
The three friends run to the park.
There they see a duck in the pond.
And floating on the pond is a sheet of paper!
But how will they get it out of the water?
Carefully she pulls the sheet to the edge.
You can't read the words anymore.
Julia makes up a little dance with a twirl and a jump.
Children in the park come to watch.
This is a brand-new song, says Hanne.
The children from the park are in the hall too.
After the concert the three friends are tired, but very happy.
But the new song is even lovelier.
